CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is bound to an identified content/presentation claim in the text.

COD.rationale: Content positions (red) are listed, an origin entry describes the record's presentation/access kind, and an explicit executed_branch_claim flag separates content from its status.

A.rationale: The text lists 'current' and 'candidate' records and processing-origin tags but contains no explicit attention/allocation claim tied to a specific content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items (red/blue) and their coordinate sets for named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/provenance fields and flags (e.g. executed_branch_claim:false) attribute status/provenance separately from the listed content coordinates.

O.rationale: The text states a display-coordinate convention and records presentation/access kinds for candidate records, describing how content is organized/presented.
